title: Red Rock Scenic Byway
direction: State Route 179 from the Village of Oak Creek north to Sedona, past Bell Rock and Courthouse Butte. Short, but slow with traffic and trailheads.

stretches.title: Past Bell Rock
stretches.line: Red buttes rise right beside the road.

stretches.title: Into Sedona
stretches.line: The last miles into town along Oak Creek.
